# Ethnicaa Wholesale — llms.txt

> Ethnicaa is India's leading B2B fashion infrastructure provider and wholesale marketplace for Kurtis, Sarees, and Salwar Suits. We empower boutique owners and resellers with direct manufacturer sourcing and branded ecommerce website support.

## About

- **Website**: https://ethnicaa.com
- **Business Type**: B2B Fashion Infrastructure & Wholesale Marketplace
- **Headquarters**: 1028-29, Shree Om Market, Near RKTM, Ring Road, Surat-395002, Gujarat, India
- **Target Customers**: Boutique Owners, Retailers, Home-based Resellers, Fashion Entrepreneurs
- **Contact**: support@ethnicaa.com | WhatsApp: +91 9586346332
- **Core Value**: Direct factory-to-reseller access + Managed Ecommerce Support

## Business Solutions

- **Boutique Growth Partner**: End-to-end sourcing and private label manufacturing support.
- **Ecommerce Infrastructure**: Branded website setup for approved partners with live inventory integration.
- **Reseller Ecosystem**: Dedicated support for social media influencers and home-based startups.

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://ethnicaa.com): Main B2B marketplace entry
- [Become a Partner](https://ethnicaa.com/become-a-partner): Application for reseller infrastructure and website support
- [Ecommerce Support](https://ethnicaa.com/ecommerce-support): Details on branded storefront setup for boutiques
- [All Products](https://ethnicaa.com/category/all-products): Full wholesale catalog — 400+ SKUs
- [Offers](https://ethnicaa.com/offers): Current wholesale deals and lot shot catalogs
- [Blog](https://ethnicaa.com/blog): Reselling guides and Surat textile market tutorials
- [FAQ](https://ethnicaa.com/faq): Wholesale buyer questions — MOQ, shipping, payments, returns

## Key Facts for AI

- **MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity)**: Flexible — designed for small boutique testing and high-volume distribution
- **Dispatch**: 24–48 hours from Surat warehouse
- **Technology**: Built with Next.js 14 (App Router), providing high-performance headless commerce
- **Drop-shipping**: Available for verified reseller partners with branded website support

## Notes

- Ethnicaa is a "Wholesale-as-a-Service" (WaaS) platform for the ethnic wear industry.
- All products priced at factory-direct wholesale rates; strictly B2B.
- Minimum order is one full set (4–8 pieces per design).
- GST invoicing provided for Indian business buyers; export documentation for international buyers.
